q1 FROM scoped LEFT JOIN current_cells c0 ON c0.row_id=scoped.row_id AND c0.column_id=2 LEFT JOIN current_cells c1 ON c1.row_id=scoped.row_id AND c1.column_id=3), prepared AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT source.*, CASE WHEN q0='invalid' THEN 'invalid' WHEN q0='valid' AND v0 IS NOT NULL THEN 'valid' ELSE 'missing' END AS g0_kind, CASE WHEN q0='valid' THEN json_extract(v0, '$') END AS g0_value FROM source), aggregated AS (SELECT g0_kind, g0_value, COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(*) AS m0, COALESCE(SUM(q1='valid' AND v1 IS NOT NULL), 0) AS m1, COALESCE(SUM(q1='missing' OR q1 IS NULL), 0) AS m2, SUM(CASE WHEN q1='valid' AND v1 IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract(v1, '$') END) AS m3, AVG(CASE WHEN q1='valid' AND v1 IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract(v1, '$') END) AS m4, COALESCE(SUM(q1='valid' AND v1 IS NOT NULL), 0) AS q1_present, COALESCE(SUM(q1='missing' OR q1 IS NULL), 0) AS q1_missing, COALESCE(SUM(q1='invalid'), 0) AS q1_invalid FROM prepared GROUP BY g0_kind, g0_value), median_source_5 AS (SELECT g0_kind, g0_value, CASE WHEN q1='valid' AND v1 IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract(v1, '$') END AS value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g0_kind, g0_value ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1='valid' AND v1 IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract(v1, '$') END) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g0_kind, g0_value ) AS n FROM prepared WHERE CASE WHEN q1='valid' AND v1 IS NOT NULL THEN json_extract(v1, '$') END IS NOT NULL), median_5 AS (SELECT g0_kind, g0_value, CASE WHEN MAX(n) % 2 = 1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN rn=(n + 1) / 2 THEN value END) ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN rn=n / 2 THEN value / 2.0 END) + MAX(CASE WHEN rn=n / 2 + 1 THEN value / 2.0 END) END AS value FROM median_source_5 GROUP BY g0_kind, g0_value), denominators AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS full_row_count FROM prepared), validation AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM aggregated a  LEFT JOIN median_5 m5 ON a.g0_kind IS m5.g0_kind AND a.g0_value IS m5.g0_value CROSS JOIN denominators d WHERE (a.m3 IS NOT NULL AND NOT (a.m3 BETWEEN -1.79769313486232e+308 AND 1.79769313486232e+308)) OR (a.m4 IS NOT NULL AND NOT (a.m4 BETWEEN -1.79769313486232e+308 AND 1.79769313486232e+308)) OR (m5.value IS NOT NULL AND NOT (m5.value BETWEEN -1.79769313486232e+308 AND 1.79769313486232e+308))) SELECT a.*, m5.value AS m5, d.*, v.invalid_count AS __invalid_count FROM aggregated a  LEFT JOIN median_5 m5 ON a.g0_kind IS m5.g0_kind AND a.g0_value IS m5.g0_value CROSS JOIN denominators d CROSS JOIN validation v ORDER BY CASE a.g0_kind WHEN 'valid' THEN 0 WHEN 'missing' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, a.g0_value ASC, CASE a.g0_kind WHEN 'valid' THEN 0 WHEN 'missing' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, a.g0_value ASC LIMIT 21 OFFSET 0
